_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior wood siding repaint. Context prefix WSRP (Wood Siding RePaint) — no collision with existing prefixes. SDNG_ is taken by SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization). First repaint spec in the system — introduces substrate_state and substrate_condition as primary configuration dimensions, DSD prep multiplier, RRP gate condition, and condition assessment module.

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface
paintable_items.notes: REUSED from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Same physical item (siding field), repaint context. Siding profile modifier (lap/board_batten/shingle) adjusts effective surface area and production rate. Add SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP to used_in array.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD. WSRP is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_WSRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_WSRP_ASSESS_CONDITION, TSK_WSRP_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE, TSK_WSRP_SCRAPE_LOOSE, TSK_WSRP_FEATHER_SAND, TSK_WSRP_PRIME_SPOT, TSK_WSRP_PRIME_FULL_SPRAY, TSK_WSRP_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_WSRP_CAULK_REPLACE

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape, hardscape, HVAC, light fixtures, vehicle/driveway
Condition assessment — DSD rating, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, MC testing, coating ID, lead evaluation. UNIQUE to repaint. Fixed-time per project. Results determine which prep tasks activate.
Surface preparation — power wash, scrape, feather-sand, chalk remediation, wood brightener. Conditional on substrate_state. DSD multiplier applies to all prep tasks.
Caulk assessment and replacement — inspect siding-to-trim joints, remove failed caulk, re-caulk. LF-based. Unique to repaint (NC caulk is always new).

Primer application — spot prime or full prime depending on substrate state and bare area percentage. 5 primer paths: spot acrylic, chalk-binding, acrylic stain-block full, alkyd stain-block (tannin), penetrating alkyd (weathered).
First finish coat — spray_backbrush, brush_roll, or brush depending on method and profile.
Intercoat inspection, light sand (QT4), dust removal. Skipped at QT2 (single finish coat).
Second finish coat. QT3/QT4 only — QT2 uses single finish coat on sound/primed surface.
Final inspection, touch-up, transition verification at trim interfaces.
Protection teardown, site cleanup, tool cleaning, waste disposal (lead-safe if RRP).

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable siding field area (square feet)

Existing coating condition state (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT / SS_EXT_CHALKING / SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT / SS_EXT_PEELING / SS_EXT_WEATHERED). Primary configuration dimension for repaint. Per-elevation if conditions differ across building.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — first repaint-specific PS key. NC specs do not need this (single state: bare wood).

paintscope_keys.description: MPI Degree of Surface Degradation (DSD 0-4): SC_SOUND / SC_SLIGHT_DETERIORATION / SC_MODERATE_DETERIORATION / SC_SEVERE_DETERIORATION / SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE. Drives prep labor multiplier. SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE = hard stop.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — DSD rating is the dominant cost driver for repaint estimation. Per-elevation.

paintscope_keys.description: Siding profile type (lap_horizontal / board_and_batten / shingle). Drives production rate selection and effective area multiplier.
paintscope_keys.notes: Board and batten = 1.20x effective area. Shingle = highest complexity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag for pre-1978 building. Triggers EPA Lead-Safe RRP requirements for all prep tasks involving paint disturbance.
paintscope_keys.notes: Project-level flag. Gate condition — not a rate modifier by itself but triggers RRP modifier on all prep tasks.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of house perimeter where landscape is adjacent and requires protection
Extended landscape overspray protection area (spray method only)
Count of exterior light fixtures to mask
Count of HVAC condenser units to cover
Adjacent driveway/vehicle area requiring protection from spray overspray. Repaint on occupied homes — vehicles may be present.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — repaint-specific. Not typically needed for NC (unoccupied construction site).

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of caulk joints to assess and replace (siding-to-trim, siding-to-window, siding-to-door junctions).
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — repaint-specific. NC caulk is always new and scoped differently. Estimated from perimeter and opening count.

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — not applicable to siding field per KD-013. QT2 is economy repaint (minimal prep on sound surfaces, single finish coat acceptable). QT2 only appropriate on SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT or SS_EXT_CHALKING with SC_SOUND/SC_SLIGHT.

application_method.notes: Spray on wood siding ALWAYS requires backbrushing for fiber penetration — no spray-only option. spray_backbrush is primary for lap/board_and_batten. Brush_roll for smaller areas or occupied-adjacent. Brush only for shingle/shake and detail areas. spray_backbrush requires 2-person crew.

sheen.notes: Standard exterior siding sheens. Satin is most common default. Flat for budget/rental. Semi-gloss for high-visibility accent.

phase.notes: Combined spec. Assess module uses 'prep' phase (assessment is part of preparation). No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for siding field tasks. LF for caulk replacement. EA for protection items and per-project assessment. FIXED for tool cleaning and condition assessment.

substrate_state.notes: 5 repaint input states from controlled_enums.json (all existing). Output states are existing. Stain states (SS_EXT_STAINED_SOLID, SS_EXT_STAINED_SEMI) explicitly excluded per KD-014. SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD excluded (NC domain).

substrate_condition.notes: DSD 0-4 mapped to SC_ enum values. SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) = HARD STOP, outside painting scope. NEW enum type — proposed for controlled_enums.json. See registry_additions_proposed.

siding_profile.notes: Configuration dimension. Drives production rate and effective area multiplier. Board and batten = 1.20x net SF. Shingle = highest complexity for both prep and coating.

product_role.notes: Primer and finish only. No sealer/clear/stain/specialty needed for wood siding repaint.

protection_level.notes: Full range needed — repaint on occupied homes may require full_mask on adjacent freshly-painted trim.

surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs exist in id_registry. Identical adjacency pattern to NC sibling (SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT). No edge work — all adjacent surfaces are separate scope. Siding terminates at trim boards.

material_system_prefix.pattern: SYS_EXT_WSRP_{DESCRIPTION} or SYS_PRIMER_{DESCRIPTION} for reusable primer IDs
existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — NC acrylic primer, different application context (bare wood vs spot/full on existing paint)
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN — NC tannin-blocker, may be reusable for repaint tannin scenarios
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING — NC bonding primer for factory-primed surfaces, not applicable to repaint
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — NC standard finish, same product may apply to repaint QT2/QT3
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — NC premium finish, same product may apply to repaint QT4

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Spot Primer
proposed_systems.notes: Spot prime bare areas only. Sound paint with isolated bare spots, or failing paint with <30% bare area. Acrylic stain-blocking primer applied by brush to exposed wood. Coverage based on affected SF, not total wall SF.

proposed_systems.name: Chalk-Binding Penetrating Primer
proposed_systems.notes: Low-viscosity, high-penetration resin that soaks through chalk residue and locks it to stable substrate. Reference product: SW Loxon Acrylic Conditioner. Applied full coverage over chalking surface after cleaning and drying. Mandatory when complete chalk removal is not achievable without substrate damage.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Full Primer
proposed_systems.notes: Full coverage acrylic stain-blocking primer. Used when >30% of surface is bare (failing heavy) or after heavy scrape (peeling). Full prime by spray_backbrush or brush_roll.

proposed_systems.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer (Tannin-Rich Wood)
proposed_systems.notes: HARD OVERRIDE when tannin-rich wood (cedar/redwood) is exposed. Alkyd stain-blocker is both tannin-blocking and adhesion-promoting. Overrides acrylic primer selection regardless of other conditions. Applied to all exposed tannin-rich wood areas.

proposed_systems.name: Deep-Penetrating Oil-Alkyd Primer
proposed_systems.notes: For weathered bare wood with degraded surface fibers. Oil-alkyd penetrates and binds loose wood fibers. Applied full coverage after sanding to remove UV-degraded gray layer. On tannin-rich species, SYS_PRIMER_STAIN_BLOCK_ALKYD may serve dual purpose (fiber-binding + tannin-blocking).

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Siding Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Standard 100% acrylic latex exterior paint. Superior flexibility for wood expansion/contraction, resists cracking. QT2 = economy grade, single coat acceptable on sound primed surface. QT3 = mid-grade (SW SuperPaint, BM Regal Select), 2 coats standard.

proposed_systems.name: Premium 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Siding Paint
proposed_systems.notes: Premium exterior paint (SW Duration, BM Aura Exterior). Superior adhesion, hide, and durability. 2 coats with raking light inspection between coats. Light sand between coats at QT4.

material_system_prefix.notes: 5 substrate-state-driven primers + 2 QT-driven finish systems. Primer selection is primarily driven by substrate_state, with tannin-rich wood as a hard override. Finish product is the same class across all states — the coating on top is always 100% acrylic latex. QT drives finish product grade, not primer selection.

proposed_consumables.name: 80-Grit Sandpaper (Weathered Wood Prep)
proposed_consumables.notes: Coarse grit for removing UV-degraded gray fibers on weathered wood. Orbital or hand sanding.

proposed_consumables.name: 120-Grit Sandpaper (Feather Sanding)
proposed_consumables.notes: Medium grit for feather-sanding paint edges after scraping.

proposed_consumables.name: Carbide Hand Scraper
proposed_consumables.notes: Primary hand scraping tool for loose/peeling paint removal. Replaceable carbide blade.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 517 (Siding Field)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard tip for spray_backbrush on lap/board_and_batten siding.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 413 (Shingle Profile)
proposed_consumables.notes: Smaller pattern for complex shingle geometry.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 3/4" Nap (Brush_Roll Method)
proposed_consumables.notes: For brush_roll application method on siding field.

proposed_consumables.name: Exterior Flexible Paintable Caulk (Polyurethane/Hybrid MS)
proposed_consumables.notes: For joint replacement. Polyurethane (Class 25/50) or hybrid MS polymer for wood-to-trim joints. Must be paintable. 3-7 day cure before painting for polyurethane.

proposed_consumables.name: Wood Brightener / Oxalic Acid Wash
proposed_consumables.notes: For weathered wood prep. Removes gray/oxidized surface layer. Applied before sanding.

proposed_consumables.name: 6-Mil Poly Sheeting (RRP Containment)
proposed_consumables.notes: Lead-safe containment. Min 10 ft from building perimeter. Conditional — only when PRE_1978 = true.

proposed_consumables.name: Lead-Safe Waste Disposal Bag
proposed_consumables.notes: Lead-safe waste collection and disposal. Conditional — only when PRE_1978 = true.

proposed_consumables.name: 60-Mesh Spray Filter (Black) for Latex
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard 60-mesh filter for latex exterior coatings through airless equipment.

proposed_consumables.name: Red Stucco Poly Tape (7 mil, 30-day UV)
proposed_consumables.notes: For rough-profile or extended spray masking on exterior. Higher adhesion than blue tape on textured surfaces.

proposed_configurations.description: 0 primer + 1 finish coat — economy repaint on sound paint
proposed_configurations.notes: Minimum viable repaint. Sound surface, good adhesion, no primer needed. Single finish coat.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime + 2 finish coats — standard repaint on sound paint
proposed_configurations.notes: Spot prime bare areas only + 2 finish coats. Full prime not needed if adhesion test passes.
Chalk-binding primer is mandatory. 2 finish coats at QT3/QT4, 1 finish at QT2.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime + 2 finish coats — failing paint <30% bare
proposed_configurations.notes: Spot prime bare areas after scrape. <30% bare does not require full prime. 2 finish coats.

proposed_configurations.description: Full prime + 2 finish coats — failing/peeling >30% bare
proposed_configurations.notes: Full prime when >30% bare or active peeling. SOP determines threshold at assessment. 2 finish coats standard.

proposed_configurations.description: Full penetrating prime + 2 finish coats — weathered bare wood
proposed_configurations.notes: Deep-penetrating oil-alkyd primer to bind loose fibers + 2 finish coats. Most coating-intensive round config.

proposed_profiles.description: Spot primer coverage on bare areas — 300-400 SF/gal. Coverage based on affected SF, not total wall SF.
Chalk-binding primer coverage — 250-350 SF/gal. Low viscosity, high penetration absorbs more product.
Full coverage primer (acrylic stain-block or alkyd stain-block) — 300-400 SF/gal on scraped/prepared surface.
Penetrating alkyd primer on weathered wood — 200-300 SF/gal. High absorption into degraded wood fibers.
Finish coat coverage on primed/repaint surface — 300-350 SF/gal smooth lap. Lower than NC due to surface irregularity from previous coating. Adjusted by siding_profile modifier.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility (per established exterior convention). Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate spec scopes. No cross-spec flags needed. RRP gate condition is project-level (would affect all repaint specs on the same project) but is handled within each spec's prep module.

existing_modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS — ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50 (existing, shared across exterior specs)

proposed_modifiers.description: DSD prep labor multiplier by substrate condition
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL prep tasks (scrape, sand, chalk remediation, caulk). Does NOT apply to coating (prime, finish) tasks — once prepped, surface is at baseline.
proposed_modifiers.stacking: Multiplicative with FAC_EXT_ACCESS. Effective Rate = Baseline Rate / (FAC_WSRP_DSD x FAC_EXT_ACCESS).
proposed_modifiers.notes: SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) is a HARD STOP, not a multiplier level. DSD-4 triggers scope exclusion. Midpoint values used from research ranges: DSD-1 use 1.15 (range 1.0-1.25), DSD-2 use 1.40 (range 1.25-1.5, rounded up), DSD-3 use 1.75 (range 1.5-2.0).

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by siding profile geometry
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL tasks (prep and coating). Profile affects both scraping difficulty and coating production. Board and batten = 1.20x effective area. Shingle has highest geometric complexity.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Same concept as NC sibling FAC_SDNG_SIDING_PROFILE (if it exists). Values from research RF-010.

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks only. QT2 = less care/rigor (economy). QT3 = baseline. QT4 = greater care, tighter tolerances.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Standard QT modifier pattern. QT2 for repaint is appropriate — economy prep on sound surfaces is a valid scope.

proposed_modifiers.description: Lead-safe RRP modifier on prep tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL prep tasks involving paint disturbance (scraping, sanding, power washing with paint removal). Adds containment setup/teardown, wet scraping methods, HEPA vacuum, lead-safe disposal overhead.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Gate condition triggered by IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 = true. The 2.00x modifier accounts for containment setup/teardown amortized across prep work plus wet method production slowdown. RRP material costs (poly sheeting, HEPA bags, waste bags) are separate consumable items.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_WSRP_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_SIDING_FIELD MUST be used exactly as registered (existing ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums
RULE 12 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): FAC_WSRP_DSD applies to prep tasks ONLY, NOT to prime/finish tasks. Coating rates are independent of previous condition.
RULE 13 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): FAC_WSRP_DSD and FAC_EXT_ACCESS stack MULTIPLICATIVELY on prep tasks. Effective Rate = Baseline / (DSD x Access).
RULE 14 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE (DSD-4) is a HARD STOP. Do NOT include in production rate tables. Triggers scope exclusion.
RULE 15 (REPAINT-SPECIFIC): FAC_WSRP_RRP is a gate condition modifier. Applies when IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 = true. Affects ALL prep tasks involving paint disturbance.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Wood Siding Repaint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for wood siding repaint. Distinct from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT — different substrate states (existing paint conditions vs bare wood), different prep pathway (condition assessment + state-driven prep vs NC prep), different primer logic (5 state-driven primers vs 3 substrate-driven), DSD prep multiplier, RRP gate condition. First repaint spec in the system.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior siding field surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: EXISTING — update used_in to include SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP. No new ID needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Sound substrate condition (DSD-0)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW ENUM TYPE — substrate_condition. MPI Degree of Surface Degradation mapped to SC_ prefix enum values. Required for repaint estimation. 5 values: SC_SOUND, SC_SLIGHT_DETERIORATION, SC_MODERATE_DETERIORATION, SC_SEVERE_DETERIORATION, SC_SUBSTRATE_DAMAGE.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Slight deterioration (DSD-1)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Part of substrate_condition enum. DSD-1 = minor wear, isolated defects.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Moderate deterioration (DSD-2)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Part of substrate_condition enum. DSD-2 = widespread minor to localized moderate failure.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Severe deterioration (DSD-3)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Part of substrate_condition enum. DSD-3 = widespread failure, PCA P14 Level R restoration.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Substrate damage (DSD-4) — HARD STOP
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Part of substrate_condition enum. DSD-4 = structural damage (rot, compromise). Outside painting scope. Triggers scope exclusion.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Spot Primer
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — spot prime for bare areas on sound/lightly-failing surfaces. Distinct from full-coverage primers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Penetrating Primer
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — specialized primer for chalking surfaces. Low-viscosity resin that penetrates and locks chalk residue. No existing system covers this.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Full Primer

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkyd Stain-Blocking Primer (Tannin Override)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — hard override primer for tannin-rich wood (cedar/redwood). Acrylic alone insufficient for severe tannin staining. May overlap with SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN from NC but different application context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Deep-Penetrating Oil-Alkyd Primer
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — for weathered bare wood with degraded fibers. Oil-alkyd penetrates and binds loose wood fibers. Different from standard acrylic or alkyd stain-block.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Siding Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — standard finish for QT2/QT3 exterior repaint. May overlap conceptually with SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD but needs separate ID for repaint coverage rates and context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Siding Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — premium finish for QT4 exterior repaint. SW Duration, BM Aura tier. Separate from NC premium for coverage rate tracking.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Spot Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Repaint spot primer coverage on bare areas — 300-400 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Chalk-binding primer coverage — 250-350 SF/gal. Higher absorption than standard.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Full Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Full coverage primer on scraped surface — 300-400 SF/gal.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Penetrating Alkyd Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Penetrating primer on weathered wood — 200-300 SF/gal. High absorption.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Repaint Finish Coat Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Finish coat on repaint surface — 300-350 SF/gal smooth lap. Lower than NC due to surface irregularity.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DSD Prep Labor Multiplier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — core repaint modifier. Drives prep task rate reduction by substrate condition severity. SC_SOUND=1.00, SC_SLIGHT=1.15, SC_MODERATE=1.40, SC_SEVERE=1.75.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Siding Profile Production Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — rate modifier by siding profile geometry. lap=1.00, board_and_batten=1.20, shingle=1.50.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — standard QT modifier for repaint. QT2=0.85, QT3=1.00, QT4=1.15.
